method: Conservative support: union of every 0<wardrobe alpha<0.998 frame (30f padding) plus every wardrobe>0 frame with muscle_cell semantic envelope or h016 muscle-return envelope>0 (30f padding). It deliberately includes frames whose final muscle alpha is suppressed by other optical factors. Computed against saved current person-alpha rows and timeline, avoiding missed opaque clothing/organ-order overlap.
limitation: Ordinary opaque scenes have very small nonzero GPU pixel differences; most <0.002 MAE. These ranges cover material garment differences and muscle overlap, not every ±1 raster difference.
